title: Design: A/P Export menu matches the native report Export menu
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/P Summary is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Reports > Finance > Sales By Customer is open in a second tab of the same window, for comparison.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Hover over the ⋯ button at the right of the title row.
  2. Click it and read the menu, letter for letter.
  3. Compare with Sales By Customer's ⋯ menu.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the ⋯ button is at the right of the title row and is labelled "Export report".
  • Step 2: "Download (PDF)", then "Download (CSV)".
  • Step 3: the same button, menu, order and position.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • S3-R1: “Each of the six reports has the native report Export menu (the ⋯ button at the right of the title row, labelled "Export report") with "Download (PDF)" and "Download (CSV)". A/R's former Print button is replaced by this menu. The A/P reports gain a PDF.”
  • Key Decisions, reuse rule: “The reuse rule. Every control on these reports reuses an existing ShopView pattern: the native filter chips, the native totals row and pinned headline column of the newer reports, the existing location-switch prompt, the design system's chevron icon. Nothing new is drawn. Basis: d-reuse-existing-pattern.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), page 2 (Export) as the PRD names it. Not yet read: the design was not available to this pass (22 Oct 2026). Until it is, this case compares with the native reports the PRD names. When the design is driven, its picture of this screen is attached here, every attribute is re-checked against it, and any difference gets a sent question and a held design-version case (Rules 120, 126, 130).
